normalization_plan.reason: sender is a local parameter of _transfer and has no independent semantic identity
recipient is a local parameter of _transfer and should be folded into the transfer function
amount is the value argument of _transfer and is not a persistent entity
tAmount is the per-call input of the balance-accounting routines, represented by _transferStandard
tokenAmount is the argument of the swap routine and belongs to the swapTokensForEth operation
time is the lock duration argument consumed by lock() to produce _lockTime
account is the target argument of excludeFromReward and has no standalone meaning
newOwner is the argument of transferOwnership and is represented by that function
takeFee is the fee-application flag of _tokenTransfer and should be folded into it
contractTokenBalance is the local amount computed in _transfer and consumed by swapAndLiquify
tLiquidity is the local liquidity portion processed by _takeLiquidity
rFee is the local reflection fee processed by _reflectFee
initialBalance is a temporary ETH snapshot used only inside swapAndLiquify
half is the temporary token amount passed to the swap routine
currentRate is a transient rate value used inside _takeLiquidity
